verdict.rationale: First-party docs state the core capability directly: "Search the web and get full page content from results in one call" [firecrawl-docs-2]. The SDK docs list search alongside scrape [firecrawl-docs-14], and the output is LLM-ready markdown or structured JSON [firecrawl-gh-9, firecrawl-docs-1]. The evidence is a one-line claim, though, with no detail on parameters or result handling and no independent corroboration; missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the search endpoint's content-retrieval options (formats, result limits, per-result scrape behavior), independent or hands-on confirmation that search returns full page content.
